correctness.rationale: For Cr_n=K_(n,n) minus a matching, N(a_i)∩S=S_B\{b_i}; omitting two b-indices yields equal signatures, and similarly on A, so necessity is ≥n−1 selected on each side. At n≥3, each side has ≥2 selected vertices, giving nonempty signatures and separating all same-side pairs; cross-side signatures are nonempty subsets of disjoint bipartitions. Consequently all OLD sets factor independently into full or one-deletion choices, O_n(z)=(z^n+n z^(n−1))^2 and min=2n−2 with n² minimizers. Independently enumerated every vertex subset for n=3,4,5,6 and compared definition directly, confirming exact polynomial; n=2 excluded because a side may have only one selected vertex and open domination fails.
